question: For which of the following productions is the Ramagundam power plant famous?
solution:
The correct answer is **__thermal energy.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Ramagundam power plant is famous for the production of thermal energy.**
 
• NTPC Ramagundam Thermal Power Plant is located in** Telangana**.
 
• It is part of the National Thermal Power Corporation,** a 2600 MW power station** located in Ramagundam, Telangana.
 
• It is currently the largest power station in South India.
 
• It is the first** "Super Thermal Power Station" ISO 14001** certified in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Important thermal plants of India:**

 
 
• **Hussain Sagar Thermal Power Station:**

 
 
• ​It is the historic thermal power plant that was located in Hyderabad, Telangana on the banks of Hussain Sagar.
 
• It was India's first thermal power station, opened in 1920 by the erstwhile seventh Nizam of Hyderabad.
 
 
 
• **Mundra Ultra Mega Power Project or Mundra UMPP:**
 
 
• It is a sub-bituminous coal-fired power plant in Tundra village at Mundra, Kutch district, Gujarat, India.
 
• It is the 3rd largest operational power plant in India.
 
• The power plant is owned by Tata Power.
 
 
 
• **The Vindhyachal Thermal Power Station:**
 
 
• It is located in the Singrauli district in the Indian state of Madhya Pradesh.
